records.quote: When expanding (a + b + c)^n, the term containing a^p b^q c^r is
records.claim: When expanding $(a+b+c)^n$, the term containing $a^p b^q c^r$ is $\frac{n!}{p!q!r!}a^p b^q c^r$.

records.quote: Find the coefficient of the term a^4b^3c in the following expansions.
records.label: Warm Up

records.quote: Explanation
records.text: Explanation

records.quote: When expanding (a + b + c)^8, the term a^4b^3c is
records.text: (a) When expanding $(a+b+c)^8$, the term $a^4b^3c$ is $\frac{8!}{4!3!1!}a^4b^3c^1 = 280a^4b^3c$. Therefore, the required coefficient is 280.

records.quote: When expanding (a − 2b + 3c)^8, the term a^4b^3c is
records.text: (b) When expanding $(a-2b+3c)^8$, the term $a^4b^3c$ is $\frac{8!}{4!3!1!}a^4\times(-2b)^3\times(3c)^1 = -6720a^4b^3c$. Therefore, the required coefficient is $-6720$.
